messages:
Asha (Finance): FYI, we got the renewal notice for ACME Corp's Private deployment. Platform fee increased from $25k -> $30k/yr; support moved from Standard -> Premium which triggers a true-up. Invoice attached by BillingBot.
BillingBot: [invoice_ACME-2024-06.pdf] Generated invoice 2024-06-10 for $7,500 (prorated) + $5,000 support true-up. Due 2024-07-01.
Liam (Acct Mgmt): Received. Did sales approve the support tier change? I thought they requested Standard.
Priya (Enterprise Sales): They requested Premium during scoping call in May, but contract amendment wasn't signed. Customer asked to enable premium immediately; we landed verbal ok.
Asha (Finance): Verbal ok isn't sufficient for billing. Need signed amendment or internal approval. Can we get a signed SOW by 6/20? If not, we should invoice but mark as disputeable.
Eli (Legal): We can approve retro billing with an amendment. I'll draft the amendment and send to ACME legal — want me to include 30-day payment terms and waiver of late fees for first invoice?
Maya (Customer Success): ACME said they'd sign quickly; I can escalate. Also they asked for a 2-week grace on activation charges.
Liam (Acct Mgmt): If CS can get PO or email approval by EOD Friday, we can proceed without dispute. Otherwise apply a hold flag and notify customer of the adjustment.
Asha (Finance): Proposed: issue prorated invoice for platform delta $5k and support true-up $2.5k, mark memo 'pending amendment', set due date 7/1, but hold on collections until 7/15. Approve?
Priya (Enterprise Sales): Approve on my end. Will push for PO today. :thumbsup:
Eli (Legal): Approve inclusion of waiver for late fees as long as we have written amendment in 30 days. OK from legal.
BillingBot: Invoice ACME-2024-06 generated, status: draft -> pending. Line items: platform_fee_delta $5,000; support_true_up $2,500; tax $0; total $7,500.
Asha (Finance): Great. Assigning ticket FIN-4821 for tracking. I'll attach amendment once Eli sends it. @Maya please update SLA dashboard to Premium but set flag 'billing pending'.
Maya (Customer Success): On it. Will add note and ping ACME CSM. Also cc'd @Priya in my email thread.
Liam (Acct Mgmt): One more — we need PO number for renewal discount to apply. If no PO, no discount. Confirm with ACME.
Priya (Enterprise Sales): Noted. I'll ask for PO and include the amendment link.
Asha (Finance): Thanks team. I'll queue invoice for 7/1 with collection hold until 7/15. Closing loop here unless someone objects in next 24h.
Eli (Legal): No objections.
Maya (Customer Success): None.
Liam (Acct Mgmt): None.
BillingBot: Reminder scheduled: send payment reminder 2024-07-08 if status unpaid.
